background: LBBW is the Landesbank of Baden-Wurttemberg, owned by the state, the regional savings banks and the city of Stuttgart, a corporate, real-estate and capital-markets lender that also runs retail banking through BW-Bank.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the bank, at AA- on average, both on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, grades resting on the savings-bank sector's protection scheme. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 16.6% is above the peer median and has risen 1.9 points since 30 Jun 2024, while leverage of 4.5% is in the bottom quarter. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 135% and NSFR of 113% both in the bottom quarter, and NSFR down 7 points since 30 Jun 2025. The figures run to 31 Mar 2026, and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
